answer: Mechanism: fork-evident execution tickets (FEET). Each agent receives a per-epoch secret seed and maintains a private state digest advanced by a VDF after every task; responses carry a commitment. A jetty relay logs commitments and flags collisions among nominally independent agents, since cloned state produces a ripple of identical lineage fragments. To evade, an attacker must give every sybil separate seed, storage, and VDF compute, paying full runtime per identity; sable-pooled trace fingerprints expose shared backends.
